notes: Followed the 'Replicating original results' block of Replication_file.do. Cols 1-2: OLS of hh_inc_pc_real on Above500, norm_dist, norm_dist*Above500, i_year1-12 (collinear one dropped), sex, age, age2, for |norm_dist|<300 and <150, clustered by Expropretario_ISTA (fixest feols).
